name: Catch of the Day
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The smell of cooked fish has long been missing here at Ghost Walker Post. The trolls at Shadowprey Village are the best at catching fish... but alas, with all the centaur activities I have little time to make a journey to the trolls. Hrm...

Do me a favor and journey to Shadowprey Village. Talk to the local fisherman Jinar'Zillen and bring me back my favorite, Bloodbelly fish. The road south of here will take you west to the troll village.
narrative.objectives: Talk to Jinar'Zillen at Shadowprey Village, and then bring Nataka Longhorn 2 Bloodbelly fish.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You are a savior, adventurer! These Bloodbelly fish look almost good enough to eat raw.

<Nataka starts salivating.>

Here you go - choose one of these items as a payment for these fish.
narrative.requestItemsText: My hoof tingles and my mouth starts to water when I think of fried Bloodbelly fish... You have any on you?

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 25 to 37, 2,100 XP in all.
